title: OpenAN A2A-T SDK 1.1.0 Released
author: OpenAN
content:
This release introduces High-Value Scenario (HVS) Prompt Templates for Fault Management (RAN, IP, OTN, Core Network), RAN Energy Saving, and Private Line Complaint Handling, conforming to TMF IG1453/IG1453A. It also adds Feasibility Negotiation and Intent Clarification Negotiation alongside the existing Information Negotiation, and adds Authorization-T support with auto-approve, manual approval, or deny policies to keep agent-driven network changes within controlled, compliant boundaries.

title: OpenAN Workflow Engine SDK 0.1.0 Released
author: OpenAN
content:
A lightweight SDK that handles protocol-layer scheduling (task dispatching, state sync, result callbacks) based on PSOP DAGs and AgentCard Skills. Business logic such as context construction and conditional routing is delegated to the application layer, keeping the SDK business-agnostic and reusable.
